ExtensionShortName.description: The short_name (maximum of 12 characters) is a short version of the application's name

ExtensionDescription.message: Provides a way to parse challenge prompts and autofill the corresponding response for websites using security/challenge grids.
ExtensionDescription.description: The description (maximum of 132 characters) of the application

BrowserActionTitle.description: The title of the browser action button

Command_AutofillGrid.message: Autofill the grid on the current page

ManageGrid_StepLabel_Error_CustomGridSet.message: Some settings need to be fixed

ManageGrid_HelperText_ChallengePatternWi.message: A regular expression that matches one challenge cell. Leave it empty to match cells like $EXAMPLE$.

ManageGrid_HelperText_InputSelectorWithP.message: A CSS selector for the response field(s). Leave it empty to use $DEFAULT$.

ManageGrid_Error_InvalidFileTypeWithPlac.message: File type must be one of the following: $TYPES$

ManageGrid_Error_InvalidGridID.message: Failed to load grid from storage

ManageGrid_Error_CustomGrid_KeySets.message: Use letters for either the columns or the rows, and numbers for the other

ManageGrid_Error_CustomGrid_ChallengePat.message: Enter a valid regular expression that doesn't match an empty string

ManageGrid_Error_StorageQuota.message: The grid couldn't be saved because the browser's sync storage is full. Delete another grid, or make this one smaller, and try again.

ManageGrid_Message_GridCreated.message: Grid created successfully. You may now close this window or make additional changes.

ManageGrid_Message_GridUpdated.message: Grid updated successfully. You may now close this window or make additional changes.

ManageGrid_Prompt_ConfirmDeleteWithPlace.message: Are you sure you want to delete grid "$ID$"?

ManageGrid_Alert_GridDeleted.message: Grid successfully deleted. Click the OK button to close this window automatically.

Notifications_Message_AutofillError.message: The challenge response ("$RESPONSE$") could not be automatically filled into the input field(s).

Notifications_Message_InvalidGrid.message: The grid with ID "$ID$" could not be found.

Notifications_Message_MissingChallenge.message: There was no challenge prompt found on the page.

Notifications_Message_ResponseError.message: A response could not be generated for the challenge: $CHALLENGE$

Notifications_Message_NoGrids.message: Add a grid from the toolbar button first, then use the shortcut again.

Notifications_Message_ChooseGrid.message: You have more than one grid. Autofill this page once from the toolbar button or the right-click menu, and the shortcut will use the same grid on this site from then on.

Notifications_HelpMessage.message: Please contact the extension author if this problem persists.

Options_SettingDescription_AutoSubmitFor.message: Enable to automatically submit the challenge form after entering the response

Options_SettingDescription_ForceDarkMode.message: Enable to force this extension to use dark mode (regardless of your system preferences)

Options_ShortcutDescription.message: Fills the grid on the current page: your only grid, or the one you last used on that site.

Options_ShortcutFirefoxHelp.message: To change it, open Add-ons and Themes, click the gear button, and choose Manage Extension Shortcuts.

Options_BugEnhancement_QuestionText.message: Found a bug? Have an idea for an enhancement?
